sources.name: Respiratory viruses data portal
sources.usage_limit: The portal combines surveillance systems with different coverage and update schedules; it is not a parcel-level infection probability.

sources.name: Influenza data dashboard
sources.published_or_current: Last updated 16 July 2026; testing data through 12 July 2026
sources.geography: England national and selectable health geographies
sources.usage_limit: Hospital admission data uses a voluntary sentinel network while ICU/HDU collection differs; positivity among tested people is not population prevalence or parcel risk.

sources.name: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) data dashboard
sources.usage_limit: RSV testing data is sentinel surveillance with explicit coverage limitations; it is not a count of all infections or a parcel measurement.

sources.name: Other respiratory viruses data dashboard
sources.published_or_current: Last updated 16 July 2026; testing through 12 July 2026
sources.usage_limit: Sentinel healthcare data is not a count of every hospital patient; testing positivity cannot be assigned to parcels.

sources.name: COVID-19 data dashboard
sources.published_or_current: Last updated 16 July 2026; latest case dates are incomplete
sources.geography: England with selectable official health geographies
sources.usage_limit: Recent specimen-date data is incomplete and reporting systems have different schedules; no household or parcel inference is allowed.

sources.name: National flu and COVID-19 surveillance reports 2026 to 2027 season
sources.geography: England community primary-care secondary-care and mortality surveillance
sources.usage_limit: The report integrates systems with different denominators and ascertainment; national and regional results cannot be copied to parcels.

sources.name: Remote health advice weekly bulletins for 2026
sources.geography: England NHS 111 calls and online assessments
sources.usage_limit: NHS 111 contacts measure care-seeking and triage activity rather than confirmed diagnoses, incidence or parcel conditions.

sources.name: Syndromic surveillance summary week 28
sources.published_or_current: Updated 16 July 2026; reporting week 6 to 12 July 2026
sources.geography: England NHS 111 GP emergency-department and ambulance systems
sources.usage_limit: Syndromic indicators are non-specific early-warning signals affected by behaviour, service use and weather; they are not parcel-level diagnoses.

sources.name: Measles data dashboard
sources.published_or_current: Last updated 9 July 2026; next scheduled update 23 July 2026
sources.geography: England with regional and local-authority reporting
sources.usage_limit: Counts are provisional, recent weeks are affected by confirmation and reporting delay, and local-authority totals cannot be assigned to parcels.

sources.name: Food Standards Agency news and alerts
sources.published_or_current: Current alert route reviewed 22 July 2026; latest indexed alerts June 2026
sources.geography: United Kingdom product, allergy and food-safety alerts within FSA remit
sources.usage_limit: Alerts apply to named products, batches and consumer actions; manufacturer or retailer location is not evidence of parcel food risk.

sources.publisher: Food Standards Agency and participating local authorities
sources.name: Food hygiene rating open data and API
sources.published_or_current: Daily data updated 21 July 2026 at 01:05; 609181 businesses listed
sources.geography: Participating local authorities across the United Kingdom
sources.usage_limit: A rating reflects hygiene standards on the inspection or visit date and is not food quality; parcel use requires exact establishment identity, address, coordinates and inspection date.

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs and Animal and Plant Health Agency
sources.name: Notifiable animal disease cases and control zones
sources.geography: England named premises areas and statutory animal-disease control zones
sources.usage_limit: Zone restrictions, opening and closing dates and disease type must be retained; historical or nearby cases cannot score a parcel without exact active-zone geometry and date intersection.
